parole.significato: A ruler of the Qara Khitai.
parole.testo: From Khitan, via Chinese and Arabic historians, see modern Mongolian гүр хан (gür xan) for details.

parole.significato: A member of the Mongolic people who ruled Manchuria, then northern China as the Liao, then Central Asia as the Qara Khi…
parole.testo: Reconstruction of Khitan 𘱿𘲫 (*qid ún, small script) or 𘱿𘱤 (*qid i, small script) under influence from Middle Chinese 契丹 (MC khejH|khj+t|khet tan). Doublet of Cathay. Compare Russian Кита́й (Kitáj, “China”) and the various forms of Cathay (“legendary northern medieval China”) in European languages.
